build.sources: gitCommit plus the changes of the commit that adds or rewrites this metadata, rendered from that working tree before committing

comparison: Compared by tests/smoke/test_golden_room.cpp with G01's tolerance (6/255 per channel, at most 0.5% of the pixels) on this GPU and driver only.
description: I5 step 4 golden of an arcade cabinet playing its clip (ADR-0016 §6 and §7): the esde/building fixture's arcade room, the cabinet of Clover Pinwheel (the fixture's one mame clip) inspected, then in Focus after Indietro, lowered to its pulled-out pose: its generated 4:3 clip held at 1.0 s on its portrait screen through the picture tube, letterboxed in the tube's black, the hover's outline and title label over it, the neighbouring cabinets' covers beside it.

image.format: PNG, 8-bit RGB, sRGB-encoded as the window shows it

fixture.name: esde/building
fixture.rule: SHA-256 of the lines "<relative path>\t<SHA-256 of the file>\n", sorted by path

run.regenerate: $env:RV_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1; build/msvc-x64-debug/bin/rv_smoke_tests.exe "golden/G20:*"; Remove-Item Env:RV_UPDATE_GOLDEN (then run it again without the variable; tests/smoke/test_golden_room.cpp)
steps: a first run of the same command but --frames 300 and without --video-freeze-pts, --spawn or --input-script: the plan generated and written, the covers into the cache

view: --start-room area:arcade --spawn at the cabinet's Focus pose (app::focusPoseFor, the 16:9 window), tests/input_scripts/golden_g20_cabinet_focus.json
